title: Don Callis betrays Kenny Omega
summary: Omega’s former adviser turns against him and backs Takeshita, carrying their conflict into Omega’s later comeback.

chapters.title: The screwdriver betrayal
chapters.result: Callis attacks Omega during the cage match with Moxley.
chapters.context: Omega loses the support of the adviser who helped make him champion.

chapters.title: Takeshita defeats Omega
chapters.context: Callis’s new protégé secures a major victory over his former client.

chapters.title: Omega wins the International title
chapters.result: Omega defeats Takeshita for the championship.
chapters.context: The returning Omega gains a title victory against Callis’s representative.
